item.title: Saudi Arabia mandates BIM for all government infrastructure projects from 2027
item.description: The requirement applies to contractors and engineering consultancies bidding on public infrastructure works, and is tied to Vision 2030 digital transformation targets. Officials said the mandate is expected to improve project productivity and reduce cost overruns.

item.title: Public Investment Fund launches $2 billion data center programme in Riyadh
item.description: The programme targets AI compute capacity for enterprise and government workloads, with construction of the first facilities beginning next year.
